mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.provider, c.config, 1 AS active, c.updated_at FROM pw_user_ai_config c JOIN pw_user_active_ai_selection s ON s.user_id = c.user_id AND s.source = 'USER' AND s.user_provider_key = c.provider WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.provider, c.config, CASE WHEN s.source = 'USER' AND s.user_provider_key = c.provider THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS active, c.updated_at FROM pw_user_ai_config c LEFT JOIN pw_user_active_ai_selection s ON s.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY active DESC, c.provider ASC

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.provider, c.config, CASE WHEN s.source = 'USER' AND s.user_provider_key = c.provider THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS active, c.updated_at FROM pw_user_ai_config c LEFT JOIN pw_user_active_ai_selection s ON s.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.provider = #{provider} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pw_user_ai_config (user_id, provider, config) VALUES (#{userId}, #{provider}, #{configJson}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, provider) DO UPDATE SET config = EXCLUDED.config, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
